name: bg-black-hole
title: Black Hole Background
blurb: Elliptical discs and particles spiral toward a central void.
description: Canvas-rendered background with animated concentric discs, radial lines, and falling particles converging toward center. Includes light/dark overlay gradients and supports children elements.
use_when: Immersive hero section with depth effect and particle dynamics.
avoid_when: Low-spec devices, high frame rate requirements, or multiple instances.
a11y: Purely decorative background animation; children must handle own a11y.
